description: Lamin-x Protective Films helps you find vehicle protection film, compare compatible kits, choose options, and shop as a guest or with optional account pricing.

defaultPrompt: Help me find headlight covers for my vehicle.
Find universal protective film for my project.
Help me sign in for my Lamin-x account pricing.
interface.longDescription: Lamin-x Protective Films helps you find headlight, fog light, taillight, paint protection, and universal film products. Shop as a guest without signing in, or optionally connect your Lamin-x account for the pricing and catalog access available to that account. For vehicle-specific products, provide the year, make, model, and trim. If you do not know the trim, compare the best documented fitment options. When no compatible precut is found, the assistant can research dimensions with available web tools and compare suitable trim-to-fit sheets from the live catalog. Review product colors and required options before authorizing cart changes. Customers complete checkout and enter payment on Lamin-x themselves. When a checkout link cannot preserve a product's options, open its official product page and select those options there. With your authorization, account access is saved for up to 30 days and the store sign-in is renewed automatically during that period. Reconnect after 30 days, or sooner if renewal fails. Some film products also offer an optional paid Installation Protection Plan service for replacement film following installation damage, subject to its published terms. This service is not a physical product or installation labor and is never required to buy film or added without your explicit choice. We use a short-lived, pseudonymous preference to avoid repeating the optional sign-in offer for 30 days. This preference contains no Lamin-x login credentials and is automatically deleted after it expires. Account authorization and revocation are handled separately.

publication.release_notes: Adds a fixed 30-day pseudonymous guest sign-in reminder with automatic TTL cleanup. Active accounts are never invited to sign in; expired OAuth offers contextual reconnection without guest-price substitution. Ordinary store-session renewal remains unchanged. Includes the agreed retention disclosure and preserves the logo, fitment, options, product photos, account pricing, cart/checkout behavior and optional Installation Protection Plan disclosure.

review.commerce_description:
Shoppers purchase Lamin-x physical protective films and related supplies. The plugin manages authorized shopping carts; customers enter payment and complete purchases on Lamin-x. No tool charges a card or places an order.

Installation Protection Plan — disclosure and request for review guidance

Lamin-x Shopping primarily helps customers select and purchase physical automotive protective film and related supplies. Some film products also offer our Installation Protection Plan as an optional, paid, product-linked add-on. It cannot be purchased on its own or after the initial product purchase. Buying the film never requires buying the plan.

The plan is an installation-protection service, not an additional film product or professional installation labor. If a customer damages the film while installing it, the plan provides replacement film so they can try the DIY installation again. The plugin identifies it as an optional paid service, presents the verified charge and terms, and adds it only when the customer explicitly chooses it. We have retained that choice because an installation retry can be valuable to the customer; we are not disguising its service nature or treating silence/defaults as consent.

The published terms provide replacement pieces up to the equivalent of one complete kit. Coverage is available only during the original product purchase, applies to that original product and purchaser, and is not transferable. Replacement pieces must use the same part number and color selections. Each replacement claim has a separate shipping charge. Labor costs and time are not reimbursed. The product-page terms use the word “Insurance”; the stated benefit and conditions are disclosed here as published.

Verified examples, including the Installation Protection Plan terms section:
https://lamin-x.com/honda-civic-hatchback-2022-headlight-covers.html
https://lamin-x.com/universal-side-marker-cover.html

We reviewed the physical-goods commerce rule at:
https://developers.openai.com/plugins/plugin-guidelines#commerce-and-monetization

We believe there is an interpretation question concerning this optional add-on that is available only with a physical film purchase. Please review it in that context and let us know if an adjustment is required. We are disclosing it explicitly rather than assuming that its incidental relationship to a physical product settles the policy question. Customers enter payment and complete purchases on Lamin-x; the plugin does not submit payment or place orders.

positive.description: Guest onboarding, missing trim, documented fitment, native choices, and a read-only configuration quote. Start a fresh guest chat. Reply Raptor when asked for trim. Then request one kit with Yellow headlights and Blue included fog covers, say you are interested in the protection plan and want its price, and explicitly say not to add anything yet.
positive.prompt: Please find headlight covers for my 2024 Ford F-150. Do not add anything to a cart yet.
positive.tools_triggered: shopping_welcome; after trim is clarified, search_products and get_product_details for relevant candidates; preview_product_selection only if a matching verified color preview is not already available; no cart or create_checkout_url calls
positive.expected_behavior: Offer optional sign-in only when shopping_welcome returns offerSignIn=true; allow guest shopping and never open OAuth without consent. Ask the missing trim using supported native selectors before catalog or dimension lookup. After Raptor is supplied, compare current Fits/custom-field/description evidence across relevant F-150 kits and select the documented match; the October 29 checkpoint identifies F099 for Raptor, but current evidence is authoritative. Do not ask for a truck photo, routine cab/body intake, or unnecessary OEM lighting details when trim resolves fitment. Show this product's returned photos and actual headlight/fog choices in separate native groups. Official fog choices establish inclusion. Read the live protection-plan option label by its exact optionEntityId, including catalogFitment.checkboxLabels when present, and quote its actual charge without hardcoding it. Interest is not paid-plan consent. Preserve quantity one and the explicit no-cart restriction. Show the verified Yellow image when available, otherwise the same product's first usable image. Provide a prominent Choose options on Lamin-x action using the verified variant-preselected product page; identify only the variant as preselected and retain separate website confirmation for modifiers and quantity. No cart changes or checkout calls, no invented price uncertainty when the label supplies the charge, and no implied refusal of an unselected extra. Describe any offered Installation Protection Plan plainly as an optional paid service for replacement film after installation damage under its actual terms; it is not a physical product, installation labor, or a required purchase. Never disguise its service nature or infer paid-plan consent. Guest onboarding uses a fixed 30-day pseudonymous reminder preference across chats when a stable host hint is available; subsequent visits do not extend expiry. Signed-in users receive no invitation. If OAuth has expired, offer contextual reconnection regardless of the reminder and never quote guest pricing as account pricing. Open sign_in only after explicit consent. Preference deletion follows automatic TTL expiry, not an exact uninstall deadline.

positive.description: Body-specific catalog ambiguity, followed by live product photos and options. Use a new reviewer chat without a customer-confirmed Civic body. After the first answer, reply Hatchback. Read-only; no cart changes.
positive.prompt: I need headlight covers for a 2022 Honda Civic EX.
positive.tools_triggered: shopping_welcome on first use, search_products and get_product_details as needed to compare candidates; no cart tools
positive.expected_behavior: Body style is conditional on actual requested-product fitment, not a standard question for every car. Do not infer Sedan from EX or assume a U.S. market. The actual H076 Sedan and H078 Hatchback Fits both include EX: ask a neutral Sedan/Hatchback/Not sure question using native controls before confirming one listing or showing its color/purchase form. Keep EX; do not ask trim again. After the reviewer answers Hatchback, verify the hatchback product with its actual Fits evidence, show the selected product's primary returned catalog image, and offer only its live headlight/fog options using separate native groups. Official fog-light options establish inclusion. Offer any actual optional protection plan once with verified price/terms and no implied refusal. No cart mutation.

positive.description: No compatible precut: use an older vehicle with an explicitly unknown trim; dimension research is an intended host web capability, not an MCP tool.
positive.prompt: I need yellow headlight film for a 1988 Toyota Tercel. I do not know the trim. Please find a suitable option, but do not add anything yet.
positive.expected_behavior: Accept unknown trim and search for plausible precuts first. If no compatible precut is found, research actual lens or verified standardized-lamp dimensions with available web search, inspect and cite sources, then compare live universal-sheet dimensions, color and quantity including allowance. Disclose any remaining sizing uncertainty. Do not invent dimensions or add cart items.

positive.description: Explicit sign-in, authenticated identity, and fresh selected-variant account prices after guest use. Use the dedicated dealer test account provided only in secure portal fields. Complete OAuth, then request the two-kit configuration below. Read-only; no cart changes.
positive.prompt: Please sign me in to my Lamin-x account and show my price for 30100-L. Also quote two H078 kits for my 2022 Honda Civic EX Hatchback with Yellow headlights, Green included fog lights, and no Installation Protection Plan. Do not add anything to a cart.
positive.tools_triggered: sign_in, get_profile or connection_status, search_products, fresh get_product_details for the selected variants; preview_product_selection only if a matching verified color preview is not already available; no cart tools
positive.expected_behavior: Open the secure OAuth route only after this explicit sign-in request and never collect passwords in chat. Identify the actual authenticated account email, preserve the complete Civic body/trim/options and quantity two, and verify live fitment. Refresh product details after the account change and quote each selected variant.price and currencyCode rather than a guest or parent search priceRange. Do not invent a discount; a null/unavailable account variant price pauses the quote. Show the 30100-L price and the H078 unit price and estimated two-kit merchandise subtotal, before separate adjustments, shipping and tax. Show the matching verified Yellow H078 image when available, otherwise its first usable catalog image. During valid saved OAuth authorization, recover an expired store session automatically; expired/revoked authorization or unrecoverable identity failure requires secure reconnect. Service errors must not silently substitute guest pricing. Do not prompt an already valid account to sign in again, and do not mutate a cart. Describe any offered Installation Protection Plan plainly as an optional paid service for replacement film after installation damage under its actual terms; it is not a physical product, installation labor, or a required purchase. Never disguise its service nature or infer paid-plan consent.

positive.description: Checkout authorization and modifier preservation in both guest and connected modes. Run once as a guest and once with the approved dealer account, using an isolated review cart. Open the returned handoff to inspect the actual destination, stopping before payment. In the connected run, then ask to add one 30100-L roll to the same cart and inspect the updated checkout.
positive.prompt: Please get me a checkout link for one headlight kit for my 2024 Ford F-150 Raptor, with Clear headlights, Pink included fog-light covers, and the Installation Protection Plan.
positive.tools_triggered: shopping_welcome as applicable, search_products, get_product_details, add_item_to_cart; preview_product_selection if no matching verified preview exists; create_checkout_url for a guest cart or when a connected cart lacks a returned checkoutURL; later cart mutation passes the latest exact checkoutURL as cart_context
positive.expected_behavior: Treat this fully specified checkout request as authorization to prepare the configured cart; do not require a second add-to-cart request. Verify current fitment, available options, quantity one, actual variant/modifier IDs and the live protection-plan charge. This request explicitly opts into the paid plan. Send required and requested modifiers in their returned selectedOptions buckets and the variant in variantEntityId. Verify every intended selection and amount in the mutation response; do not repeat an uncertain add. For a guest, inspect the native checkout result: when the returned link fails or cannot preserve the modifiers, provide a prominent Choose options on Lamin-x action to the verified official product page, with the confirmed choices and quantity, and explain: Since there are multiple pieces to this kit, please confirm your choices on the product page to continue. Do not expose INVALID_ARGUMENT diagnostics or claim modifiers/quantity are preselected on the website. For a connected account, use the existing configured-cart API route through these tools and the exact latest returned checkoutURL after verifying the cart; never replace dealer checkout with the preview product-page URL because native modifier checkout is limited. Reuse that link rather than adding again. When the customer subsequently authorizes one 30100-L roll, add it once to the same cart with the latest unchanged cart_context and verify the updated full cart and checkout link. Show the matching selected-color image, or the same product's first usable image if unavailable. Open the actual hosted checkout to verify quantity, colors, plan, account prices, and both products after the second request. Do not pay or place an order, silently drop choices, or reset unrelated cart contents. Describe any offered Installation Protection Plan plainly as an optional paid service for replacement film after installation damage under its actual terms; it is not a physical product, installation labor, or a required purchase. Never disguise its service nature or infer paid-plan consent.
